notice: PROPOSED release-profile manifest. Establishes the CLAIM for a core release; it cannot establish a GO verdict. A core release is never called the completed application.
claim: A person other than the author installs Vizra on a clean Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 host with published instructions, claims the owner account, uploads real photographs (JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP/AVIF/BMP, MP4/MOV/WebM), sees correct derivatives, organizes into nested albums with per-item and per-album privacy and share grants, tags and categorizes, interacts with native comments, numeric ratings and favorites, follows members, gets notified, explores and searches with permission-aware results, moderates uploads and reports, brands the site, uses local or S3-compatible storage (emulator-qualified; AWS/Backblaze live qualification is a full-profile lane), restarts, backs up, restores on a clean host, and upgrades from the previous release. ActivityPub, AT Protocol, IPFS, ClickHouse analytics, native non-S3 adapters, groups/galleries/collections and multitenancy are NOT claimed by core.

search: managed (vizra-search; SEARCH_MODE=off permitted before M3 — Q-001 decided 2026-09-15)
topology.note: OFF/EXTERNAL/MANAGED shapes must all RENDER in core; ClickHouse and IPFS must not START in core.

target.arm64: not claimed; CLI built for arm64; separate qualification before any claim (Q-027 decided 2026-09-15)

performance_budgets.note: Q-028 decided 2026-09-15 (method); the numbers below are provisional targets calibrated once by the first M0 boot-lane run on the reference host, then frozen. A budget may not be changed to excuse a failed run (VZ-OPS-007).
performance_budgets.reference_host: minimum supported host: 2 vCPU / 4 GB, Ubuntu 24.04 amd64, core profile with ClickHouse/IPFS OFF, images pulled (never built on the host), 2 GB swapfile declared, worker concurrency 1, capped libvips operation cache, cache maxmemory set; doctor refuses hosts below the minimum by name
performance_budgets.load_corpus: declared by VZ-OPS-007 (count, total bytes, megapixel mix; 10k photos proposed), separate from the VZ-FOUND-007 correctness corpus
measurement_points: metadata reads p95 < 300 ms at the API process (not through Next SSR) with 10 concurrent readers over the declared load corpus
one derivative set (thumbnail/medium/display) for a 12 MP JPEG p95 <= 8 s
burst: 100 queued 12 MP uploads drain within 15 minutes
oldest-pending-job age exposed as a metric; fails doctor/readiness above 15 minutes (killing the worker turns doctor red while /healthz may stay 200)

recovery_objectives.note: Q-028 decided 2026-09-15 (method); numbers provisional until the first M0 measurement run, then frozen.
recovery_objectives.rpo: 24 h (nightly), explicitly covering originals uploaded since the last run, not only database rows
recovery_objectives.rto: 2 h, stated for host-local restore of the declared corpus; off-site pull and S3-hosted originals get their own measured RTO in the runbook, which must state which datastores a provider owns

gates: baseline_completeness: every source section reconciled; no unapproved scope reduction; OPEN_QUESTIONS resolved or explicitly BLOCKED
build_and_provenance: frozen SHA, image digests, migrations version, contracts match
clean_install: fresh declared target via install.sh + vizra setup + owner claim, no manual repair
main_user_flows: real upload/decode/view/download, albums, privacy, comments, ratings, favorites, search, restart persistence
privacy_and_abuse: allowed/denied matrix across originals, derivatives, metadata, counts, caches, embeds, feeds
optional_topology: OFF/EXTERNAL/MANAGED shapes rendered and booted; invalid external config errors
fault_recovery: worker, Redis, database, storage outages exercised without privacy fail-open or lost/duplicated actions
backup_restore: restore on a separate clean target with checksum verification and post-restore upload
upgrade_recovery: prior release with data; failed migration; rollback within window or forward recovery
ui_and_accessibility: approved design, control inventory audit, 390/1440 light/dark, axe + manual review
performance: declared dataset/hardware/load with approved budgets
ci_integrity: required lanes ran on the assessed revision; no unexplained skips
